paragraphs: Rav Shemayah Hasida, mentioned in Zohar, Devarim, and in the Tikkunim as the elder who appeared in a shadow. He was nasi, the mystery of a spark of Moshe our teacher, peace be upon him: Gilgulei Neshamot. Shemayah and his brother Ahiyah were killed on the twelfth of Adar. They were pious, but he did not explain who they were, for the one whom the lion ate was Iddo: Rashi, end of Ta'anit chapter 2. See Hiddushei Aggadot there on Rashi's intention.
